title: D6-04 BOTTOM + arm end, one 5-axis part (user's bar cut at s 255, strap fused into its channel; 7075-T6)
frame: STEP coordinates = the part's group-local frame (equal to the rig frame when the group is at identity: x anterior, y up, z lateral, origin = GH centre)

principal_axes_extents.note: extents of the part along its principal axes of inertia (density-free)

frame.note: arm_end.py frame of the user's BOTTOM bar (arm rest frame = this STEP's frame): s = (p - CB).uB is the station up the bar from the elbow-hinge axis

bottom.bar_sections_note: sections square to the bar at station s (2D x = vB across the bar, y = axB away from the arm, origin = CB + s uB); s 225..254 cut through the fused tongue

frame.note: pad-plane sketch: origin OAm on the J3 axis at the pad mid-plane (F3 + 1.5), x = d (down the arm), y = yA = k3 x d; channel-plane sketch: x = d, y = yB = axB x d

strap.common_line_note: the planes' common line is where the strap's pad mid-plane and channel mid-plane meet; the bend R is tangent to both, so the line lies Rb / cos(th/2) from the bend axis, on the bisector
strap.tongue_note: tongue = the 8 mm strap in the channel plane after the R7.5 turn, running down the arm to a full-round end; it is fused into BOTTOM's web (embedded 1 mm) so its faces inside the channel are merged; see channel-plane turn centre and bar sections s225..s254
